claim: In Q1 2026, Apple's net income came in at $48.4 billion or more.
summary: Apple's Q1 2026 net income (whether fiscal Q1 ending Dec 2025 reported late Jan/early Feb 2026, or calendar Q1 2026 reported Apr/May 2026) is after the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04. With tools prohibited, no evidence is available to verify the claimed threshold, so the assertion cannot be established.

sub_claims.text: Apple's net income in Q1 2026 was $48.4 billion or more
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 precedes any reporting of Apple's fiscal Q1 2026 (Dec 2025 quarter) or calendar Q1 2026 results; without tools no evidence can be retrieved to confirm or contradict the $48.4B threshold.
